headline: Moroccan Dirham Market Spread Exceeds 1% Over Central Rate
summary: The spread between market foreign exchange rates and the central reference rate set by Bank Al-Maghrib exceeded 1% over consecutive sessions amid dollar demand.
why: Bank Al-Maghrib regulates Morocco's currency band; widening spreads signal foreign exchange liquidity pressures.

impacts.name: Moroccan Dirham
impacts.why: Commercial market rates diverged past 1% from the central bank baseline due to strong US dollar demand.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Heightened demand for US dollars drove the market exchange rate spread beyond 1% over Bank Al-Maghrib's benchmark rate.
